import unittest

from solution import ReservationBook


class ReservationBookTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_release_and_snapshot_order(self):
        book = ReservationBook({"a": 1, "b": 2})
        book.add("c", 3)
        self.assertEqual(list(book.snapshot().keys()), ["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(book.release("b"), 2)
        self.assertEqual(book.snapshot(), {"a": 1, "c": 3})

    def test_unknown_release_raises_without_changing_state(self):
        book = ReservationBook({"known": {"value": 1}})
        before = book.snapshot()
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            book.release("missing")
        self.assertEqual(book.snapshot(), before)

    def test_stored_none_is_distinct_from_unknown_ticket(self):
        book = ReservationBook({"none": None})
        self.assertIsNone(book.release("none"))
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            book.release("none")

    def test_constructor_add_release_and_snapshot_are_deeply_isolated(self):
        initial_value = {"nested": [[1], {"x": 2}]}
        initial = {"a": initial_value}
        book = ReservationBook(initial)
        initial_value["nested"][0].append(99)
        initial["new"] = 3
        self.assertEqual(book.snapshot(), {"a": {"nested": [[1], {"x": 2}]}})

        added = {"items": [[4]]}
        book.add("b", added)
        added["items"][0].append(5)
        snapshot = book.snapshot()
        snapshot["a"]["nested"].clear()
        snapshot["b"]["items"][0].append(6)
        self.assertEqual(book.snapshot(), {
            "a": {"nested": [[1], {"x": 2}]},
            "b": {"items": [[4]]},
        })

        released = book.release("b")
        released["items"][0].append(7)
        self.assertEqual(released, {"items": [[4, 7]]})
        self.assertEqual(book.snapshot(), {"a": {"nested": [[1], {"x": 2}]}})

    def test_duplicate_add_raises_without_replacing_value(self):
        book = ReservationBook({"ticket": {"old": 1}})
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            book.add("ticket", {"new": 2})
        self.assertEqual(book.snapshot(), {"ticket": {"old": 1}})

    def test_empty_default_book(self):
        self.assertEqual(ReservationBook().snapshot(), {})
        self.assertEqual(ReservationBook(None).snapshot(), {})

    def test_constructor_validation(self):
        for initial in [[], "bad", 3, {"": 1}, {3: 1}]:
            with self.subTest(initial=initial):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    ReservationBook(initial)

    def test_ticket_argument_validation(self):
        for ticket_id in ["", None, 1, b"x"]:
            with self.subTest(ticket_id=ticket_id):
                book = ReservationBook()
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    book.add(ticket_id, 1)
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    book.release(ticket_id)
                self.assertEqual(book.snapshot(), {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
